# VStack Business Solutions

> We Stack Your Business. Complete technology partner for software, digital marketing, hardware, and IT in Kerala, India and worldwide.

## Company

- **Legal name:** VStack Business Solutions
- **Also known as:** VStack, We Stack, We Stack Business Solutions, We Stack Your Business, V Stack, V Stack Business Solutions, VStack India, We Stack India, V Stack India
- **Website:** https://vstackbusinesssolutions.com/

- **Location:** Kerala, India · Remote worldwide
- **Founded:** Technology partner since 2025

## What we do

VStack Business Solutions provides end-to-end business technology:

- Custom software development (ERP, CRM, billing, POS, inventory, automation)
- Digital marketing (social media, SEO, Meta & Google ads, content)
- Website and mobile app development (Flutter cross-platform)
- Hardware & office IT setup (computers, printers, networking, AMC)
- CCTV and security systems
- Technical support and maintenance

## Products (VStack-owned)

- **QuickRent** — Rental shop billing & management (Windows & Android, offline-first): https://vstackbusinesssolutions.com/products/quickrent
- **KATTAR, VFarm, Mizhionline, DealApp** — Upcoming platforms (waitlist)
